title: AI Gateway Amazon Bedrock Anthropic Messages passthrough: build a new invoke body, Claude models with API key auth only
answers: Why does /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages return 501 for a Bedrock-hosted Claude endpoint?
Does the Anthropic Messages passthrough work on Bedrock with IAM role or access key auth?
How is the model ID or inference profile ARN sent to Bedrock on the Anthropic passthrough route?
Where is the Anthropic Messages passthrough for Amazon Bedrock handled?
body:
Path: `POST /gateway/anthropic/v1/messages` on an endpoint whose model is a Claude model on Amazon Bedrock (regular model IDs or inference profile ARNs). Requests with native Messages fields such as `thinking` and `output_config` go through `mlflow/gateway/providers/bedrock.py:AmazonBedrockProvider._passthrough`, which posts to `model/{model}/invoke` on the bearer-token Bedrock runtime host.
Rule: `_passthrough` builds a new body that drops `model` and `stream` and adds `anthropic_version: bedrock-2023-05-31`; it must not mutate the caller's payload, because `FallbackProvider` hands the same payload to the next provider. The model ID is escaped with `quote(name, safe=":")` so ARN slashes form a valid path. Client auth headers are removed with `_drop_client_auth_headers` (including a credential agent's own key) and the endpoint's bearer token is added. `PASSTHROUGH_PROVIDER_PATHS` in `AmazonBedrockProvider` is what advertises the `ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES` action.
Symptom: Bedrock-hosted Claude endpoints returned 501 on the Anthropic Messages route, so provider-native parameters like `thinking` were unreachable, and a Bedrock fallback leg returned 501 whenever it failed over.
Constraints: Non-Anthropic Bedrock models are rejected with 400. SigV4 auth modes (access keys, IAM role, default credential chain) return 501; only API key (bearer token) auth is implemented. Client `anthropic-beta` headers are not translated to Bedrock's `anthropic_beta` field.
applies: AI Gateway Anthropic Messages passthrough for Amazon Bedrock endpoints; not the boto3 invoke_model path used for other Bedrock routes.
says: Sending Anthropic Messages requests to our Bedrock Claude endpoint returns a 501 not implemented.
Allow Claude parameters like thinking on Bedrock endpoints through the AI Gateway.
Bedrock fallback endpoints fail with an unimplemented error during gateway provider failover.
Why does our Bedrock Claude gateway endpoint reject IAM role authentication with error 501?
Enable API key bearer token authentication for Bedrock Claude endpoints on the gateway.

It creates a new body dropping model and stream, setting anthropic_version: bedrock-2023-05-31 without mutating caller payloads used by FallbackProvider, escapes model IDs or inference profile ARNs via quote(name, safe=":"), strips client auth headers via _drop_client_auth_headers, and attaches the bearer token. PASSTHROUGH_PROVIDER_PATHS in AmazonBedrockProvider advertises ANTHROPIC_MESSAGES. Non-Anthropic Bedrock models return 400, SigV4 auth returns 501 since only API key auth is supported, and client anthropic-beta headers are not forwarded to Bedrock's anthropic_beta field.
